avis.titre: New packaging, same formulaNew packaging, same formula
avis.texte: Caudalie Vinopure Moisturizing Mattifying Fluid arrived in a simple light green tube container, factory sealed with no retail box. Authentic product with the brand's identifying mark all present. Fresh batch as per code printed on top tube seal. I was initially a bit nervous when I saw the new updated packaging for this skincare producut, but I’m so relieved to find it’s the same old formula but in a significantly larger packaging with a slightly different bottle design. It’s rare for a brand to refresh the look without messing with ingredients, but I think Caudalie simply wanted to modernize the look of their packaging (I noticed it with their fragrances in recent months too). This fluid still manages to be genuinely mattifying without being drying. Has a soft, almost powder like finish despite going on like a gel-cream hybrid. It doesn’t give me a "flat" look; it just looks like healthy, balanced skin. The texture is incredibly lightweight and easily absorbed, making it the perfect base for SPF because there’s zero pilling or greasiness. I only use this moisturizer in the summer when it's crazy hot outside so definitely need sunscreen layered on top. It’s a very simple mattifying lotion, a quintessentially French drugstore product. It's not a luxury facial moisturizer, it won't minimize fine lines or does anything extraordinary, but keeps hydrated throughout the day without allowing shine to come through. avis.titre: Great product.
avis.texte: Great product. Smells good, not greasy and quickly dries matte. It does leave the skin somewhat hydrated but feels rejuvenated, soft, and nice. I’ve only been using it for a week or so I can’t really say that this help control and manage blackheads or acne; however, I have really sensitive skin and this has not irritated my skin or have I had any breakouts due to it.

avis.texte: Great face lotion. Doesn’t feel heavy or greasy. A little goes a long way which is awesome

avis.titre: Clean Hydration with Shine ControlClean Hydration with Shine Control
avis.texte: Finding a moisturizer that keeps everything balanced is the goal here. I’m a huge fan of Caudalie and it’s a brand I trust so I was curious to see how this would fit into my routine. I wanted something that could manage my T zone and pores while keeping the rest of my face comfortable. I wasn’t sure a moisturizer this light would help with midday shine but I decided to try it. Texture and Feel The consistency is thin and spreads easily. It sinks in fast and doesn’t leave any weight behind. The finish is soft and matte with a smooth feel. The scent is faint and clean with a botanical note that fades almost immediately after I apply it. Application and Routine The squeeze tube makes it easy to control how much I use after my serum. It layers cleanly under sunscreen and doesn’t pill under makeup. Because it's so light a small amount covers my whole face which means the tube should last a while. Performance and Results This has helped keep my oily areas from getting too shiny by midday. My pores look clearer and I haven’t seen any new congestion since adding it in. It gives enough hydration to keep my skin looking healthy without adding glow where I don’t want it. Ingredients Callout This formula uses plant polyphenols, squalane and silica to help keep skin clear and balanced. The polyphenols support the pore clearing side of things while the squalane adds a light layer of hydration without any heaviness. The silica helps with that soft matte finish. avis.titre: Lightweight moisturizer that keeps the shine down
avis.texte: The texture is super light - almost feels like a gel-cream - and it sinks in really quickly. I don’t get that heavy or sticky feeling after applying it, which is usually my biggest issue with moisturizers. It gives enough hydration without making my face look greasy an hour later. What I noticed after about a week is that my T-zone wasn’t getting as shiny throughout the day. It’s not a completely matte, flat look, but more of a balanced finish. I still blot a little by the end of the day, but way less than before. It layers nicely under sunscreen and makeup, too. I haven’t had any pilling issues, and my foundation seems to sit better when I use this underneath. I haven’t seen any dramatic changes with breakouts, but it also hasn’t caused any new ones, which is already a win for my skin. It just keeps things more stable and less oily overall. The scent is light and kind of fresh - noticeable when you apply it, but it fades pretty quickly. Overall, I’d say it’s a solid everyday moisturizer if you’re trying to control shine without drying your skin out. It’s simple, effective, and easy to work into a routine.

avis.titre: Bought for teenager with oily nose
avis.texte: I purchased this for my teenager because she complains that her nose is so oily that her glasses slide down. She said it works to keep them up and seems happy with it. It is pricey but I guess it is worth it.

avis.titre: A lightweight daily moisturizer that delivers on shine control
avis.texte: I've been using this as my daytime moisturizer for a while and it's become a consistent part of my routine. The texture is genuinely lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any greasiness or heavy film behind. It sits well under makeup and doesn't pill, which is the practical test that matters most for a day moisturizer. The mattifying effect is real. Shine stays controlled noticeably longer than with richer creams, and my pores look more refined throughout the day. The grapeseed polyphenols and silica powder seem to be doing their job. It also pairs well with a purifying toner if you're building a routine focused on keeping combination or oily skin balanced. A couple of things worth knowing. The texture can feel slightly tacky on first application and works better on slightly damp skin rather than completely dry. It leans toward oil control rather than deep hydration, so if your skin runs dry this probably isn't the right fit. For combination to oily skin in warmer months it hits the right balance. The 60mL size is modest but a little goes a long way, so it lasts reasonably well for the price.

avis.titre: Only need a little
avis.texte: I’ve been using this daily for a while now and I’m really happy with how it feels. The texture is super light and it spreads easily without feeling heavy or greasy. One thing I noticed right away is how quickly it absorbs, which makes it perfect to use in the morning before sunscreen or anything else. It helps keep my skin looking more matte throughout the day, especially in areas where I usually get a bit oily. It doesn’t make the skin dry and that’s what I was worried about. It also doesn’t clog my pores or irritate my skin, which is important for me since I can be a bit sensitive to new products. It feels like a good balance between hydrating and controlling oil, which is not always easy to find. The packaging is clean and easy to use as well. The smell is actually pleasant and it feels very premium when I’m putting it on, I noticed I only ever really need a little bit. Overall it feels like a solid everyday moisturizer, especially if you want something light that keeps your skin looking fresh. (Especially if you sweat easy or layer it)

avis.titre: 4.5/5 My daughter really likes it, and her skin is looking better. Fragrance isn’t the greatest.
avis.texte: Over the last year, my teenage daughter has started to experience common skin changes like oilier skin and breakouts, as well as a bit of worsening keratosis pilaris on her cheeks. She was using a gentle facial moisturizer before this, but it wasn’t really helping much with the oiliness and breakouts she’s been dealing with. Since this one is formulated for oily and acne-prone skin, I thought it was worth trying. She’s been using it for about a month now, and her skin has improved from where it was before. It seems to be keeping the oil under control better, and her skin has been clearer. There has also been an improvement with texture, especially the areas where she has KP. That’s not to say she hasn’t had any blemishes, but they’ve been fewer and more mild. It’s done a good job of keeping her skin hydrated, and her skin just looks a bit better in general. She likes how it feels on her skin, and she’s happy with the improvements she’s seen. To be fair, skin naturally goes through phases where it looks better or worse, so I can’t say this moisturizer is solely responsible for the improvements, but it does seem to be helping. Fortunately, a little seems to go a long way. It has a thinner, more fluid consistency, which is easy to spread. It does have a fairly strong fragrance, which I was initially concerned might irritate my daughter‘s skin, but that turned out not to be the case. avis.titre: This worked exactly as described
avis.texte: As someone with combination, acne-prone, and sensitive skin, I'm always a little leery about trying out new skincare products. I spend a lot of time researching brands and ingredients and read many reviews before introducing something new. But even then I still occasionally run into issues. When I ordered this moisturizer, I didn't have overly high expectations. I was just hoping for a product that moisturized well without leaving me greasy. And while it was not my original intent, I unexpectedly got to try out it's claims of helping remove blackheads because I had recently been using a sample of a different moisturizer that left me with blackheads. I didn't put much thought into the acne claims when I originally ordered the product, but I will admit I was blown away by the results. In less than a day, my weeks long blackheads battle was won. They were completely gone. Literally... Gone in one day. I had actually forgotten that was a claim of this moisturizer until I went back to review it because I just could not believe how quickly it helped my skin recover. While impressed by the quick improvement to my skin, I can also acknowledge it wasnt a completely perfect match for me, so I did opt to take off a star for a couple of reasons. First, a minor gripe is the fragrance. It's a strong citrus scent, which I don't mind in general, but fragranced skincare is not my preference. The good news is that the smell dissipates quickly. avis.titre: Finally a moisturizer that doesn't fight my oily T-zone
avis.texte: I've been hunting for a daytime moisturizer that doesn't slide off my face by lunchtime, especially now that the weather in my area is starting to swing humid. My T-zone gets oily by mid-morning and most lightweight moisturizers I've tried either feel like nothing or break me out within a week. The bottle is a slim white tube with a small nozzle that gives you tight control over how much comes out. The formula itself is a thin gel-cream that's almost watery when it first hits your fingers but turns silkier as you spread it. The scent caught me off guard. It's herbal in a way that leans slightly medicinal, like a mix of grape leaves and something faintly green-onion-adjacent for the first ten seconds before it fades. I didn't love it on day one, but I've stopped registering it by now. I've used it morning and night for six days, applying after my serum and before sunscreen. A pea-sized amount covers my whole face with some left over for my neck. It absorbs in under a minute and leaves a soft, almost powdery finish that genuinely keeps my forehead and nose from going slick until at least mid-afternoon, which is new for me. It hasn't pilled under my SPF or my tinted moisturizer, and my skin actually feels comfortable rather than tight, which a lot of "oil-control" formulas get wrong. avis.titre: Keeps my skin balanced without feeling heavy
avis.texte: I grabbed this because I love Caudalie and already use 3 other products from their Vinopure line. I’m in my late 30s with oily skin that’s not exactly acne-prone, but I deal with blackheads and sebaceous filaments and need something that controls shine without drying me out. The texture is somewhat thin and spreads smoothly & easily across my face. It absorbs fast and doesn’t leave any weight or tackiness behind. The finish is soft with a slight matte quality that keeps my T-zone from getting greasy by midday. The scent is one of the best parts and I love their fragrance from this liner. It’s clean and botanical with a fresh herbal quality that doesn’t smell like typical skincare. It’s pleasant without being sweet or cloying, and it fades quickly after application. All the Vinopure products smell great, and this is no exception. I use this after my toner and serums, and it layers cleanly without pilling. That’s significant when you’re stacking multiple products like I do. It doesn’t interfere with my sunscreen or makeup either. The formula kept my pores from getting congested, which can happen when I use something too rich. My skin looks clearer and feels hydrated without the shine I’d normally see by afternoon. It’s non-irritating and hasn’t caused any sensitivity or breakouts. The squalane gives enough moisture to keep my skin comfortable, but the silica keeps it from crossing into greasy territory. Overall this is excellent value for what it does. It balances oil control a

avis.titre: Matte finish without drying, helps keep shine under control.
avis.texte: I really like this oil-control lotion so far. I use the Caudalie Vinopure toner and love the difference it's made with my skin's texture over time, so I was excited to try this oil control moisturizer from the same line. I'm in my 40s with combination skin and still get occasional hormonal breakouts around my T-zone where my skin is oily. I usually only use lotion in the evening because my skin will look way too shiny with moisturizers during the day. This lotion did not have that problem. The lotion comes in a small tube, and only a small amount is needed to cover the face. It feels moisturizing going on with a slight tingle when you first apply, but it dries to a matte texture. The formula includes silica and tapioca starch, which helps create that long-lasting matte finish. It also has squalane and glycerin for lightweight hydration. The combo of ingredients helps keep my skin looking balanced and shine-free for several hours before I notice any oil coming through. One thing to note is this isn't fragrance-free. The lotion has a light refreshing scent that dissipates quickly after application. It didn't bother me or irritate my skin. Overall, this is a great face lotion option if you have combination or oily skin. This is one of the few daytime moisturizers I've tried that doesn't leave me looking greasy.

avis.titre: Not for my skin type...
avis.texte: I have 48 year old skin that's going through changes because of age and wanted to try this Caudalie Vinopure oil control moisturizer specifically to do that, control oil so that I don't have obsess over acne AND aging skin. This moisturizer comes in a a squeeze tube with a seal on the end. The cream itself smells great, I like citrus scent. The cream itself is thick and stays put. It goes on very matte, there is no shine but my skin feels hydrated. For the first few days I wore this moisturizer during the day around the house to see how it performs. It shrinks the pores and evens out my skin tone (I have very fair skin so if my skin is blotchy it's super noticeable). My skin is calm and clear (no redness) when using this moisturizer. On the 4th day or so I decided to use this cream under makeup and go out but the product does not hold up well under foundation. There areas on the forehead where you can see dry patches and flaky skin. I like this Caudalie oil control moisturizer but it's just not enough for my aging skin. I need deeper hydration, I'll pass this on to a family member as I think it is a great value for the money but just not for my skin type.

avis.titre: My acne prone skin is responding really well, doesn't make it shiny or irritated.
avis.texte: I have been using this in conjunction with the Caudalie Vinopur Gel Cleanser and Caudalie Purifying toner. Before this I had never used Caudalie in the past so I had no preconceptions about them. My skin while late 30s, still occasionally gets hormonal acne and cystic acne on my chin. While I used a ton of really nice, pricey products I still kept running into this acne issue. Now that I have used the combination of these three for about a month my skin is looking clearer than it has in a long time. The moisturizer itself comes with a seal (very important to me in this day and age). It absorbs well and feels good on my skin. I don't look super shiny or greasy, and yet it is moisturizing enough that my skin doesn't feel tight or flaky. It stays on and hydrates for a while, I don't feel my skin getting dry throughout the day. Even though the bottle is small and could be used to travel, it is lasting quite a while and I still have probably another month to go. The fragrance is mild and pleasant. All in all, I am very pleased and will keep using this and the combination with cleanser and toner.

avis.titre: Trusted brand. Absorbs quickly into a powder finish.
avis.texte: In case they edit the listing with more options later, I'll clarify this review is specific to Caudalie's Vinopure Oil-Control Moisturizer. The first thing I noticed that was the product name didn't match the listing, but I'll treat the listing more as a describer and in that sense they make sense. This is a nice moisturizer- too many people think oily skin doesn't need moisture but that's not always the case. This goes on like a standard lightweight lotion but it absorbed quickly into a fairly invisible smooth finish (almost a powder finish) which was lovely - I liked how my skin felt after. The scent isn't my favorite... it's a medicinal herb which makes sense for Caudalie, but has something thats a bit onionyti me that I found lingered. It was odd as I'm very familiar with Caudalie over the years and even this particular line from other products but only this one stood out. Whether its a value to you will vary greatly by budget and your needs, but I do think it supports a more niche skincare market since many products are marketed more as "moisturize drench" or the overly shiny "glass skin" type. If you aren't familiar, Caudalie is an awesome brand committed to quality and is constantly exploring new products which has kept it on my favorites list for well over a decade.

avis.titre: Lightweight Moisture with a Natural (Not Fully Matte) Finish
avis.texte: This is a well-formulated, lightweight moisturizer that feels nice to use, but it’s clearly designed for a more oil-prone, blemish-focused routine than mine. It has a light, slightly floral scent and spreads very easily. The texture is lightweight but still feels genuinely moisturizing—it doesn’t dry down in a way that feels tight or stripped, which I appreciated. On my skin, it left more of a natural, slightly dewy sheen rather than a fully matte finish. I personally prefer that look, but it’s worth noting if you’re expecting a very mattified result. I also appreciated that it felt clean and non-heavy and did not contribute to any clogged pores when I used it. It doesn’t include SPF, so you’d need to layer that separately if using it during the day, but that’s not unusual for this type of product. Overall, this feels like a solid option in its category—lightweight, comfortable, and easy to use. For me, it was pleasant but not something I specifically needed, since I don’t struggle much with breakouts.

avis.titre: You'll love this!
avis.texte: This is one of those products that just works and reminds me why Caudalie never disappoints. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, but it still gives enough hydration to keep my skin comfortable. It does a great job at controlling oil throughout the day and helps keep that shine in check without making my skin feel dry or tight. I have not noticed a strong fragrance but rather it has a clean light smell. I’ve noticed my skin looks smoother and more balanced with regular use, especially in areas where I tend to get a little oily. It layers well with other products and fits easily into both a morning and evening routine. The price is on the higher side for a moisturizer, but it really feels worth it for the quality and how well it performs. This is a repeat purchase for me for sure.

avis.titre: A moisturizer that really ticks off a lot of boxes!
avis.texte: My college-aged daughter still has the occasional breakout so she’s really embraced Caudalie’s Vinopure line. She fell in love with the Vinopure toner and when she found out I had picked up the mattifying moisturizer, she was over the moon. This moisturizer checks multiple boxes with one product. It is another step that help keeps her acne under control. It’s moisturizing, she her skin is always hydrated and never dried out from trying to treat her acne. Her favorite part is the mattifying effect, especially in hot weather, where her t-zone looks like an oil slick. This moisturizer fixes that issue perfectly. Caudalie’s Vinopure line has a lovely grapeseed scent to it that is refreshing and smells like a spa. She and I love that part of this line, and this moisturizer has that scent, but it’s not overwhelming, and it doesn’t last for long. This moisturizer isn’t cheap. A small amount goes a long way, so a tube lasts a long time. It’s definitely an extravagance, but it’s nice to treat yourself every once in awhile, and it’s worth it since it’s also treating our skin so well.

avis.titre: Absolutely love the matte finish
avis.texte: For someone like myself who struggled with acne pretty bad in my teen years, I’m now in the part of my life where my skin has recovered but I have to MAINTAIN it. This oil-control moisturizer was a godsend of a find through the Vine Program and I was really impressed after trying it out for the first time. There is a light and clean fragrance, and the texture of the cream is bordering on a watery-gel-like feel. This is perfect because it’s starting to get hot and I need something that’s going to keep my skin hydrated; not smothered. The moisturizer soaks in quickly and delivers lasting hydration all day long. This perhaps might be my newest favorite moisturizer to pair with SPF as well. It just is so incredibly lightweight that it really makes a difference how much my face sweats in a day. I haven’t experienced any breakouts yet, and my complexion looks amazing with the matte finish of this product. I hate feeling shiny or that god-awful “dewy” look that everyone is into now. This travel sized tube is expensive but it’s a great buy. I would order this product with my own money again.

avis.titre: Great add-on for oily/combo skin, but not a standalone
avis.texte: I have the rest of the Caudalie Vinopure line, and overall I’d rate the collection around 4.5/5 for oily to combination skin. It’s especially good if you deal with a shiny T-zone or midday grease. That said, this moisturizer feels more like an add-on to the rest of the Caudalie vinopure line, rather than something I’d rely on as my only face moisturizer. It has the same floral, slightly herbal scent as the rest of the Vinopure line. The texture is lightweight and thin, spreads easily, and leaves a soft, velvety finish on the skin. There’s silica in the formula, which helps absorb excess oil throughout the day, and the grape seed polyphenols help prevent blackheads by reducing oxidation. It’s also sulfate- and paraben-free, which fits with the brand’s clean skincare positioning. Value-wise… it’s Caudalie. This is about as fair as their pricing gets. You’re paying for the R&D and the whole prestige clean skincare thing, so if you already like the line, it fits right in.

avis.titre: Love Caudalie and their Vinopure line!
avis.texte: I absolutely love all things Caudalie but their Vinopure line has been working wonders on my skin! This Caudalie Vinopure Oil-Control Moisturizer the last of the line I needed and am loving it! I have fairly sensitive skin and have had no adverse reactions. There is a mild scent to it but very subtle and not bothersome to me! This moisturizer is super lightweight and a little goes a long way! Not greasy or sticky feeling at all! It absorbs beautifully and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and calm!! It also does give a matte like finish AND it helps with bumps, so you would think it would feel tight or drying but that’s not the case at all! Complete opposite! Caudalie’s whole Vinopure line has really been a game changer for my skin! Less bumps, less oil, refreshed skin! I adore this line and this moisturizer! Worth every penny!

avis.titre: Lightweight and Matte Perfection!
avis.texte: I’m a huge fan of the Caudalie Vinopure Oil-Control Moisturizer. While it looks like a cream, it applies like a lightweight gel that absorbs instantly without any tacky or sticky residue. The scent is subtle and clean, avoiding that heavy 'perfumey' fragrance sometimes found in other products. It leaves a fantastic matte, blurred finish, ideal for anyone who wants to avoid a greasy look. As someone who generally dislikes the skin feel of a heavier greasy product on my skin, this has become my perfect everyday facial moisturizer. Highly recommended!

avis.titre: good moisturizer
avis.texte: This is Caudalie Oil Control Moisturizer. The moisturizer comes in a 60ml, it doesn't seem that big, it's more like a travel size moisturizer. The moisturizer has a light, pleasant scent, The scent doesn't linger so it doesn't bother me too much. The moisturizer absorbs well to the skin, I used it on top a Caudalie serum and it kept my skin soft and hydrated. The skin really looked a lot more refreshed in the morning when I use it before bed. It didn't cause any redness or irritation. The price is a bit high for a small tube but it works well and has good quality
